title: Three Mornings and One Short Lamp
subtitle: 天气气候 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）
meta: 主题语境：天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）　|　核心词汇：fog　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 fog 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1967 the driver ① walked into a fog that no keeper in the valley would have described, and he said the walking was the whole of the morning. The ② fog, meaning the mist itself and not the cloud, ran three mornings and stayed undescribed in the book; a fog, he said, is the only thing in a valley that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ fog in that valley had the same short lamp beside it, and the ④ fog at the far bend, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A fog, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the driver said the describing is the part that fills three mornings.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the fog was the whole of the matter, meaning the confusion and not the mist. The ⑥ fog, meaning the confusion and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; fog, he said, is either something you walk into or the only word that means both a mist and a confusion. He said the confusion is the part they remember.

By 1974 the ⑦ fog had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short lamp. The ⑧ fog of the whole thing, the driver wrote in November, was one valley and three mornings of describing; fog, he said, is either the one at the far bend or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ fog I remember is the one described in the plan, which closed in 1976 and is still described as the quietest in the valley. A ⑩ fog, my mother said in 1978, is the only one that improves by being described; every fog, she said, is a confusion that has agreed to look like a mist. She said the confusion was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 雾（指山谷里每一场旁边的那一场）
B. n. 雾（指那一场本身，与云相对）
C. 固定搭配：walk into a fog 走进一场雾里
D. n. 雾（指留给孩子们的那一道）
E. n. 雾（抽象总称，指一个山谷的雾之事）
F. n. 雾（指计划里写到、被描述过的那一场）
G. n. 迷糊；困惑（in a fog，指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样东西）
H. n. 困惑（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人说破的那样东西）

items.q: walked into a fog that no keeper in the valley would have described
The fog, meaning the mist itself and not the cloud
the fog at the far bend
the fog was the whole of the matter
the fog had become a line in a plan
The fog of the whole thing
A fog, my mother said in 1978

answers.why: walk into a fog 意为“走进一场雾里”，1967 年那位司机走进了一场山谷里没有一位看守人肯描述的雾。
fog 意为“雾”，指那一场本身而不是云，它经过了三个早晨而在簿子上没有被描述。
fog 意为“雾”，指山谷里每一场旁边的那一场，每一场旁边都有同一盏矮矮的灯。
fog 意为“雾”，指留给孩子们的那一道，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
fog 意为“迷糊、困惑”，指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样东西，叔叔说这份迷糊就是那件事的全部。
fog 意为“困惑”，指人人都等却无人说破的那样东西而不是那一场雾，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
fog 意为“雾”，指计划里写到、被描述过的那一场，到 1974 年这一场成了计划里的一行。
fog 意为“雾”，司机十一月写道，整件事的雾之事是一个山谷和三个早晨的描述。
fog 意为“雾”，我记得的是计划里描述过的那一场，1976 年结束了，至今仍被说成山谷里最安静的一场。
fog 为抽象总称，母亲 1978 年说，一场雾是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的东西。
